user.title: Hoval CAN
user.description: Connect to your Hoval WLAN gateway (CAN-BUS TCP stream, port 3113).

data_description.host: IP address of the Hoval WLAN gateway on your local network.
data_description.port: TCP port of the CAN-BUS stream (default: 3113).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable on port 3113.

data_description.heater_power_kw: Rated power of the electric DHW immersion heater (Heizstab). Common values: 2.0, 3.0, 6.0 kW. Default: 3.0 kW. Check the unit data plate. COP is calculated automatically from live sensor data and is not configurable here.
data_description.cooling_power_w: Electrical power drawn during passive (free) cooling, when the heating circuit status is 9. This is mainly the circulation pump(s); the compressor is off. Range 0-500 W, default 100 W.
